ar: لَهُ خِطَابِىَ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ فِى وَطَنِى
وَبَانَ لِى أَمْسِ مَا قَدْ صَارَ بُرْهَانَا
tr: lahu khitaabiya yawmas sabti fii watanii
wa baana lii amsi maa qad saara burhaanaa
bayts.fr: C'est à Lui que s'adresse ma parole, le jour du samedi, en ma patrie ; et hier m'est apparu ce qui est devenu une preuve éclatante.
bayts.en: To Him my words are addressed, on Saturday, in my homeland; and yesterday there appeared to me what has become a clear proof.
bayts.it: A Lui si rivolge la mia parola, il giorno di sabato, nella mia patria; e ieri mi si è manifestato ciò che è divenuto prova evidente.

ar: نَبَّهْتَنِى أَمْسِ زِدْ فَيْضًا وَمَعْرِفَةً
وَسَرْمَدًا بِىَ نَوِّرْ رَّبِّ أَذْهَانَا
tr: nabbahtanii amsi zid faydan wa mahrifatan
wa sarmadan biya nawwir rabbi azhaanaa
bayts.fr: Hier Tu m'as éveillé : accrois l'effusion (fayḍ) et la connaissance (maʿrifa), et à jamais, ô Seigneur, illumine par mon entremise les esprits.
bayts.en: Yesterday You roused me: increase the outpouring (fayḍ) and the gnosis (maʿrifa), and forever, O Lord, illumine minds through me.
bayts.it: Ieri mi hai destato: accresci l'effusione (fayḍ) e la conoscenza (maʿrifa), e per sempre, o Signore, illumina per mio tramite le menti.

ar: إِجْعَلْ رُجُوعِى إِلَى قَيْمِى سَعَادَتَنَا
وَلْتَكْفِنَا يَوْمَ جَمْعِ الْخَلْقِ نِيرَانَا
tr: ijhal rujuuhii ilaa qaymii sahaadatanaa
waltakfinaa yawma jamhil khalqi niiraanaa
bayts.fr: Fais que mon retour en ma demeure soit notre bonheur, et au Jour du Rassemblement des créatures préserve-nous des feux (de l'Enfer).
bayts.en: Make my return to my abode our happiness, and on the Day the creatures are gathered keep us from the fires (of Hell).
bayts.it: Fa' che il mio ritorno alla mia dimora sia la nostra felicità, e nel Giorno del Raduno delle creature preservaci dai fuochi (dell'Inferno).

ar: هَبْ لِى بِفَضْلِكَ كَوِنِى سَرْمَدًا فَرَحًا
لِّلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَخَلِّدْ فِيكَ بُشْرَانَا
tr: hab lii bifadlika kawnii sarmadan farahan
lil muslimiina wa khallid fiika bushraanaa
bayts.fr: Accorde-moi, par Ta grâce, d'être à jamais une joie pour les musulmans, et rends éternelle en Toi notre bonne nouvelle.
bayts.en: Grant me, by Your grace, to be forever a joy to the Muslims, and make our glad tidings everlasting in You.
bayts.it: Concedimi, per la Tua grazia, d'essere per sempre una gioia per i musulmani, e rendi eterno in Te il nostro lieto annuncio.

ar: مَلِّكْنِىَ الْيَوْمَ شَيْئًا لَّا يُفَارِقُنِى
مِنَ الْبُشَارَاتِ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ جِيرَانَا
tr: mallikniyal yawma shay-an laa yufaariqunii
minal bushaaraati fid daarayni jiiraanaa
bayts.fr: Accorde-moi en possession aujourd'hui une chose qui ne me quitte pas : des bonnes nouvelles qui, dans les deux demeures, me soient voisines.
bayts.en: Grant me possession today of something that never leaves me: glad tidings that in the two abodes stay close beside me.
bayts.it: Concedimi in possesso oggi qualcosa che non mi abbandoni: lieti annunci che nelle due dimore mi siano vicini.

ar: عَلَيْكَ أُثْنِى بِأَبْكَارٍ أَجِىءُ بِهَا
مِنَ الْفُيُوضِ الَّتِى تَنْصَبُّ وِدَانَا
tr: halayka usnii bi-abkaarin ajii-u bihaa
minal fuyuudil latii tansabbu widaanaa
bayts.fr: Je Te loue par des louanges vierges, jamais encore prononcées, que j'apporte des effusions qui se déversent abondantes comme des pluies.
bayts.en: I praise You with virgin praises, never spoken before, that I bring from the outpourings that pour down abundant as rains.
bayts.it: Ti lodo con lodi vergini, mai prima pronunciate, che reco dalle effusioni che si riversano copiose come piogge.

ar: لِى سُقْ دَوَمًا فُتُوحَتٍ أَكُونُ بِهَا
بُشْرَى لِمَنْ بِهُدَى الْإِسْلَامِ قَدْ دَّانَا
tr: lii suq dawaman futuhaatin akuunu bihaa
bushraa liman bihudal islaami qad daanaa
bayts.fr: Conduis vers moi sans fin des ouvertures (futūḥ) par lesquelles je sois une bonne nouvelle pour qui a embrassé la guidance de l'Islam.
bayts.en: Lead to me endlessly openings (futūḥ) through which I may be glad tidings for whoever has embraced the guidance of Islam.
bayts.it: Conduci a me senza fine aperture (futūḥ) per le quali io sia un lieto annuncio per chi ha abbracciato la guida dell'Islām.

ar: أَنْتَ الْعَلِيمُ الَّذِى عَلَّمْتَ حِزْبَكَ مَا
فَاقُواْ بِطَيِّكَ مِيدَانًا فَمِيدَانَا
tr: antal haliimul lazii hallamta hizbaka maa
faaquu bitayyika miidaanan famiidaanaa
bayts.fr: Tu es le Savant (Al-ʿAlīm), qui as enseigné à Ta troupe ce par quoi, grâce à Ton raccourcissement des distances (ṭayy), ils ont devancé une arène après l'autre.
bayts.en: You are the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), who taught Your company that by which, through Your folding of distances (ṭayy), they outstripped one field after another.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Sapiente (Al-ʿAlīm), che hai insegnato alla Tua schiera ciò per cui, grazie al Tuo accorciare le distanze (ṭayy), hanno superato un campo dopo l'altro.

ar: كَوِّنْ لِّىَ الْيَوْمَ تَيْسِيرًا يُسَهِّلُ لِى
صَبْعًا بِإِيجَادِ مَا قَدْ كَانَ فُقْدَانَا
tr: kawwin liyal yawma tabsiiran yusahhilu lii
sabhan bi-iijaadi maa qad kaana fuqdaanaa
bayts.fr: Fais exister pour moi, aujourd'hui, une facilité qui me rende aisé de retrouver, par Ton acte de faire être, ce qui était perdu.
bayts.en: Bring into being for me, today, an ease that makes it easy for me to recover, by Your bringing into being, what had been lost.
bayts.it: Fa' esistere per me, oggi, un'agevolezza che mi renda facile ritrovare, con il Tuo far essere, ciò che era andato perduto.

ar: ثَبِّتْ جَنَانِى وَسَدِّدْ مَنْطِقِى وَقِنِى
لَحْنًا بِإِعْدَامِ مَا قَدْ كَانَ وُجْدَانَا
tr: sabbit janaanii wa saddid mantiqii waqinii
lahnan bi-ihdaami maa qad kaana wujdaanaa
bayts.fr: Affermis mon cœur, rends droite ma parole, et préserve-moi de la faute de langage, en anéantissant ce qui était présent (dans l'âme).
bayts.en: Make my heart firm, make my speech upright, and keep me from error of tongue, by annihilating what had been present (in the soul).
bayts.it: Rendi saldo il mio cuore, rendi retta la mia parola, e preservami dall'errore di lingua, annientando ciò che era stato presente (nell'anima).

ar: يَسِّرْ لِىَ الْيَوْمَ يَاوَهَّابُ جُمْلَةَ مَا
أَرْجُو وَهَبْ لِىَ تَقْدِيمًا وَرُجْحَانَا
tr: yassir liyal yawma yaa wahhaabu jumlata maa
arjuu wa hab liya taqdiiman wa rujhaanaa
bayts.fr: Rends aisé pour moi aujourd'hui, ô Donateur (Al-Wahhāb), tout ce que j'espère, et accorde-moi la préséance et la prééminence.
bayts.en: Make easy for me today, O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), all that I hope for, and grant me precedence and pre-eminence.
bayts.it: Rendi agevole per me oggi, o Donatore (Al-Wahhāb), tutto ciò che spero, e concedimi la precedenza e la preminenza.

ar: رَبَّيْتَنِى رَبِّ فِى الْأَعْدَآءِ مُغْتَرِبًا
حَتَّى رُجُوعِىَ لِىلْأَوْطَانِ قَدْ حَانِا
tr: rabbaytanii rabbi fil ahdaa-i mughtariban
hattaa rujuuhiya lil awtaani qad haanaa
bayts.fr: Tu m'as élevé, ô Seigneur, en exil parmi les ennemis, jusqu'à ce que soit venu le temps de mon retour au pays.
bayts.en: You nurtured me, O Lord, in exile among enemies, until the time of my return to the homeland had come.
bayts.it: Mi hai cresciuto, o Signore, in esilio tra i nemici, finché è giunto il tempo del mio ritorno in patria.

ar: مَلِّكْ عُبَيْدَكَ مَا يَخْتَارُ مِنْكَ بِلَا
مَكْرٍ وَلَا سَلَبٍ وَجْعَلْهُ مِذْعَانَا
tr: mallik hubaydaka maa yakhtaaru minka bilaa
makrin walaa salabin wajhalhu mizhaanaa
bayts.fr: Accorde en possession à Ton humble serviteur ce qu'il choisit de Toi, sans ruse ni privation, et rends-le docile et soumis.
bayts.en: Grant Your humble servant possession of what he chooses from You, without scheming or deprivation, and make him docile and submissive.
bayts.it: Concedi in possesso al Tuo umile servo ciò che egli sceglie da Te, senza insidia né privazione, e rendilo docile e sottomesso.

ar: مَلِّكْهُ يَارَبِّ مَا فَاقَ الْمُنَى كَرِمًا
يَامَنْ يُّصَيِّرُ مَنْ قَدْ جَاعَ شَبْعَانَا
tr: mallik-hu yaa rabbi maa faaqal munaa kariman
yaa man yusayyiru man qad jaaha shabhaanaa
bayts.fr: Accorde-lui en possession, ô Seigneur, par générosité, ce qui dépasse tout vœu, ô Toi qui rassasies celui qui a souffert de la faim.
bayts.en: Grant him possession, O Lord, out of generosity, of what surpasses every wish, O You who satisfy whoever has suffered hunger.
bayts.it: Concedigli in possesso, o Signore, per generosità, ciò che supera ogni desiderio, o Tu che rendi sazio chi ha patito la fame.

ar: نَاجَاكَ مُرْتَجِيًا أَنْ لَّا تُخَيِّبَهُ
وَلْتَكْفِنِى يَوْمَ بَعْثِ الْخَلْقِ مِيزَانَا
tr: naajaaka murtajiyan an laa tukhayyibahu
waltakfinii yawma bahsil khalqi miizaanaa
bayts.fr: Il T'a adressé sa prière intime, espérant que Tu ne le déçoives pas : épargne-moi, au Jour de la Résurrection des créatures, (l'épreuve de) la Balance.
bayts.en: He has addressed You in intimate prayer, hoping You will not disappoint him: spare me, on the Day the creatures are raised, (the trial of) the Balance.
bayts.it: Ti ha rivolto la sua intima preghiera sperando che Tu non lo deluda: risparmiami, nel Giorno della Resurrezione delle creature, (la pena della) Bilancia.

ar: خَيِّبْ رَجَآءَ الَّذِى يَقْلِيهِ فِى أَبَدٍ
مِّنْ عَامِ عِيقَ وَكَانَ الْحَجُّ مِيزَانَا
tr: khayyib rajaa-al lazii yaqliihi fii abadin
min haami hiiqa wa kaanal hajju miizaanaa
bayts.fr: Déçois à jamais l'espoir de celui qui le hait, depuis l'année où il fut retenu (en exil), quand le Pèlerinage fut sa balance.
bayts.en: Frustrate forever the hope of whoever loathes him, since the year he was held back (in exile), when the Pilgrimage was his balance.
bayts.it: Delude per sempre la speranza di chi lo detesta, fin dall'anno in cui fu trattenuto (in esilio), quando il Pellegrinaggio fu la sua bilancia.

ar: لَهُ اكْتُبِ الْعَامَ أَجْرًا لَّاانْقِطَاعَ لَهُ
فِى كُلِّ مَا فِيكَ يَنْوِى مِنْ هُدًى زَانَا
tr: laktubil haama ajran lan qitaaha lahu
fii kulli maa fiika yanwii min hudan zaanaa
bayts.fr: Pour lui (Ton serviteur) décrète cette année une récompense sans interruption, en tout ce qu'il projette, pour Toi, de bonne guidance qui orne.
bayts.en: For him (Your servant) decree this year a reward without interruption, in all that he intends, for You, of adorning guidance.
bayts.it: Per lui (il Tuo servo) decreta quest'anno una ricompensa che non conosca interruzione, in tutto ciò che, per Te, egli intende di retta guida che adorna.

ar: قَلِّبْ قُلُوبَ الْعِدَى طُرًّا لِّنُصْرَتِهِ
فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ يَامَنْ إِنْ تُلِى لَّانَا
tr: qallib quluubal hidaa turran linusratihi
fil barri wal  bahri yaa man in tulii laanaa
bayts.fr: Retourne les cœurs de tous les ennemis vers son soutien, sur terre et sur mer, ô Toi qui, si Tu le veux, les rends dociles.
bayts.en: Turn the hearts of all the enemies to his support, on land and on sea, O You who, if You will, make them yield.
bayts.it: Volgi i cuori di tutti i nemici a sostenerlo, sulla terra e sul mare, o Tu che, se Lo vuoi, li rendi docili.

ar: نَاجَاكَ مُرْتَجِيًا مَّا رَامَ فِى عَجَلٍ
يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ أَمَّهُ مَنْ كَانَ عَجْلَانَا
tr: naajaaka murtajiyan maa raama fii hajalin
yaa khayra man ammahu man kaana hajlaanaa
bayts.fr: Il T'a adressé sa prière intime, espérant ce qu'il a désiré sans tarder, ô le Meilleur de ceux vers qui l'on se dirige, fût-ce le plus impatient.
bayts.en: He has addressed You in intimate prayer, hoping for what he longed for without delay, O Best of those to whom one turns, even the most impatient.
bayts.it: Ti ha rivolto la sua intima preghiera sperando ciò che ha bramato senza indugio, o Migliore di quanti accolgono chi si dirige a loro, anche il più impaziente.

ar: أَنْتَ الْمُعِيدُ الَّذِى أَبْقِى الْبَقَآءَ بِهِ
دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى فَهَبْ لِى الْعَوْدَ مَوْلَانَا
tr: antal muhiidul lazii abqil baqaa-a bihi
dunyaa wa ukhraa fahab lil hawda mawlaanaa
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui fait revenir (Al-Muʿīd), par qui j'obtiens la permanence en ce monde et dans l'autre : accorde-moi donc le retour, ô notre Maître.
bayts.en: You are the Restorer (Al-Muʿīd), through whom I gain permanence in this world and the next: so grant me the return, O our Master.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che fa ritornare (Al-Muʿīd), per il Quale ottengo la permanenza in questo mondo e nell'altro: concedimi dunque il ritorno, o nostro Signore.

ar: تَرَكْتُ مَا كَانَ لِى بِالْبَيْعِ مُبْتَغِيًا
مَّا عِنْدَ مَنْ لِّىَ يَقْضِى حَاجَتِى الَانَا
tr: taraktu maa kaana lii bil bay-hi mubtaghiyan
maa hinda man liya yaqdii haajatii laanaa
bayts.fr: J'ai laissé ce qui était à moi, en le vendant, recherchant ce qui est auprès de Celui (Allah) qui maintenant comble mon besoin.
bayts.en: I have left what was mine, by selling it, seeking what is with Him (Allah) who now fulfils my need.
bayts.it: Ho lasciato ciò che era mio, vendendolo, cercando ciò che è presso Colui (Allah) che ora esaudisce il mio bisogno.

ar: فَتَّاحُ وَهَّبُ يَارَزَّاقُ يَامَلِكِى
لِى افْتَحْ وَهَبْ لِىَ وَارْزُقْنِى بِكُنْ لَّانَا
tr: fattaahu wahhabu yaa razzaaqu yaa malikii
liftah wa hab liya waarzuqnii bikun laanaa
bayts.fr: Ô Celui qui ouvre (Al-Fattāḥ), Donateur (Al-Wahhāb), ô Pourvoyeur (Ar-Razzāq), ô mon Roi : ouvre-moi, donne-moi et pourvois-moi par Ton « Sois ! », avec douceur.
bayts.en: O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), O Provider (Ar-Razzāq), O my King: open for me, give to me and provide for me by Your "Be!", with gentleness.
bayts.it: O Apritore (Al-Fattāḥ), Donatore (Al-Wahhāb), o Provveditore (Ar-Razzāq), o mio Re: aprimi, donami e provvedimi con il Tuo «Sii!», con dolcezza.

ar: ضَيْقِى أَزِلْ عَاجِلًا بِالْبِشْرِ مَعْ مَدَدٍ
حَتَّى أُقِيمَ لِدِينِ اللَّهِ أَرْكَانَا
tr: dayqii azil haajilan bil bishri mah madadin
hattaa uqiima lidiinil laahi arkaanaa
bayts.fr: Ôte sans tarder ma gêne par la joie et le secours, afin que j'érige des piliers pour la religion de Dieu.
bayts.en: Remove my hardship without delay with gladness and aid, that I may raise pillars for the religion of God.
bayts.it: Rimuovi senza indugio la mia angustia con la letizia e il soccorso, affinché io innalzi pilastri per la religione di Allah.

ar: يَسِّرْ رُّجُوعِى لِطُوبَى وَاحْمِنِى وَقِنِى
أَذَى الْوَرَى وَلْتُطِبْ لِى ثَمَّ إِسْكَانَا
tr: yassir rujuuhii lituubaa wahminii waqinii
azal waraa waltutib lii samma iskaanaa
bayts.fr: Rends aisé mon retour à Ṭūbā (Touba), protège-moi et préserve-moi du mal des créatures, et rends agréable pour moi là-bas ma demeure.
bayts.en: Make easy my return to Ṭūbā (Touba), protect me and keep me from the harm of creatures, and make my dwelling there pleasant for me.
bayts.it: Rendi agevole il mio ritorno a Ṭūbā (Touba), proteggimi e preservami dall'offesa delle creature, e rendi gradita per me là la mia dimora.

ar: لَكَ السَّمَآ وَالْأَرَاضِى وَالْهَوَآءُ بِلَا
مُشَارِكٍ لِّىَ رُضْ مَنْ شِرْكُهُ بَانَا
tr: lakas samaa wal araadii wal hawaa-u bilaa
mushaarikin liya rud man shirkuhu baanaa
bayts.fr: À Toi appartiennent le ciel, les terres et l'air, sans aucun associé : dompte pour moi celui dont l'association est manifeste.
bayts.en: Yours are the heaven, the earths and the air, without any partner: subdue for me whoever manifestly associates (others with You).
bayts.it: A Te appartengono il cielo, le terre e l'aria, senza alcun socio: piega per me chi palesemente Ti associa (altri).

ar: أَجِبْ وَصَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَى سَنَدٍ
مُحَمَّدٍ وَلْتَهَبْ لِى فَآئِقًا بَانَا
tr: ajib wa salli bitasliimin halaa sanadin
muhammadin waltahab lii faa-iqan baanaa
bayts.fr: Exauce, et répands prière et paix sur l'Appui (As-Sanad), Muḥammad ; et accorde-moi un don éminent et manifeste.
bayts.en: Answer, and pour forth blessing and peace upon the Support (As-Sanad), Muḥammad; and grant me an eminent and manifest gift.
bayts.it: Esaudisci, ed effondi benedizione e pace sul Sostegno (As-Sanad), Muḥammad; e concedimi un dono eccelso e manifesto.
